explanation: The Almighty Creator who has given His will through the prophets and now His own Word in the person of the Son.
The term for the religious regulations, offerings, and rituals from the Old Testament that were a shadow of the reality.
The animals that were slaughtered during the Jewish cult ritual to symbolize atonement for sin.
A concept referring to breaking God's will and law, creating a barrier between humanity and God.
The symbol of life given in sacrifices; Jesus' blood represents the final atonement.
The holy place in the temple where God's presence dwelt, now replaced by heaven where Jesus has entered.
The concept of trusting in God and His promises without first seeing physical proof.
God's innocent grace that grants forgiveness and justification, not based on human works.
Completely genuine or true; describes the reality Jesus has brought in contrast to the shadow of the law.
